notes: Counts and reply timings are aggregated from the Buy Reviews sheet for the five requested cities.
Duplicate Kolkata entry is consolidated. Vizag is normalized to Visakhapatnam in source rows.
Reply SLA is the share of replied reviews with recorded reply time at or under 24 hours; reply rate is calculated over all reviews.
November visits use the supplied monthly Buy Delivery snapshot, whose exact as-of boundary is unspecified.
Negative reviews with a reply are a response-coverage proxy, not proof the customer was won back.
